# Live Subtitles

> Live Subtitles is an app for Windows, macOS, iOS and Android that shows real-time
> AI captions and dual (two-language) subtitles for any audio playing on the
> device — Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Skype, YouTube, Netflix, games and
> any other app. It captures system audio directly, so no microphone is needed.
> Speech is transcribed and translated live into 60+ languages (69 translation
> targets), with the original and translated line shown together.

Key facts:
- Product: Live Subtitles (publisher: 2Sub / getlivesubtitles.com)
- Platforms: Windows (Microsoft Store), macOS and iOS (App Store), Android (Google Play); a TV version is in development
- Microsoft Store rating: 4.7/5 from 351+ ratings
- Pricing: 3-day free trial, no credit card; paid plans from $5/month
- Core features: real-time captions from system audio, dual subtitles
  (original + translation), 60+ translation languages, ~66 recognition language
  variants, works offline with local models or online providers, Game Mode overlay
- Typical uses: multilingual meetings, watching foreign movies/videos, language
  learning with dual subtitles, accessibility (deaf/hard-of-hearing), gaming
